line_items.work_text: Ex-post facto approval to the notification issued for financial assistance to families whose livelihood have been seriously affected by flood and other natural calamities through Direct Benefit Transfer

Ex-post facto approval to the notification issued for Financial assistance to families that remained marooned for longer duration due to embankment breach for additional 10 (ten) days through Direct Benefit Transfer
Ex post facto approval against Fund Released by the Revenue & Disaster Management Department under different HoA till 25-09-2024.
Ex-Post Facto approval to 3 SDRF projects executed by the Water Resources Department for the year 2022-23 amounting to Rs. 553.35 lakhs

narrative: SEC approved various ex-post facto notifications for financial assistance related to flood and natural calamities, and discussed the Standard Operating Procedure for DRR proposals.
